build_BaseHawk_model: build a BaseHawk RNN model using BaseHawkArgs to configure dim, n_layers, and n_heads
create_RGLRU_module: create an RGLRU gated recurrence module with configurable heads, head_dim, and optional conv_size
create_RGLRUBlock_module: create an RGLRUBlock that combines RGLRU recurrence with gated output and residual connections
test_HawkBlock_forward: test the HawkBlock forward pass combining RGLRU and feed-forward layers with RMSNorm
review_sqrt_bounded_derivative: review the SqrtBoundDerivative autograd function that clips sqrt gradients to prevent explosion
